official.deadline_note: The 2026 intake ran from 30 March to 31 May 2026 until 23:59 Astana time. The official page announces each intake's window when it opens, so no next-cycle closing date is published yet.
official.application_cycle: 2026 intake: 490 bachelor's, 50 master's and 10 PhD places
official.status_note: The official page states applications are submitted online from 30 March to 31 May 2026 (23:59 Astana time); that window has closed and the next intake window will be announced on the same page.
benefits: Government-funded study places at Kazakh universities participating in the programme: 490 bachelor's, 50 master's and 10 PhD places for the 2026 intake
Application for the full period of study may be completed in Kazakh, Russian or English
eligibility: The applicant is eligible if each education level is pursued for the first time
Identity document required, including a refugee certificate
Bachelor's applicants: the average score of the document confirming secondary education must be at least 'good'
Master's and PhD applicants: the previous education document must come from an educational institution with a GPA of at least 3.0 out of 4.0 or its equivalent
Master's and PhD applicants: an international language-proficiency certificate is required unless previous education was in the programme's language
A health certificate for travellers to study abroad, plus a certificate on the absence of HIV infection and AIDS issued by the official health authority of the applicant's country of residence
PhD applicants: substantiation of the topic of the dissertation research in the language of instruction (Kazakh, Russian or English)
requirements: Motivational essay in Kazakh, Russian or English

One letter of recommendation (bachelor's) or two letters of recommendation (master's and PhD) in Kazakh, Russian or English from the educational organisation where the applicant studied, or from the employer
Application form using the official template published on the site
Letter of invitation from a Kazakhstan university (if available)
documents: Identity document, including a refugee certificate
Document on the previous level of education with transcript and attachment, with a notarised translation into Kazakh, Russian or English
Motivational essay in Kazakh, Russian or English
Letter(s) of recommendation from the educational organisation or employer
Health certificate for travellers to study abroad and HIV/AIDS status certificate from the official health authority of the country of residence
Application form completed per the official template
application_method: Consult the list of participating universities and available fields of study on the Study In portal during the application window
Register and apply online at https://studyin.kz/admission
Complete the application for the full period of study in Kazakh, Russian or English
official.application_route: Apply online at https://studyin.kz/admission during the published window (2026 intake: 30 March - 31 May 2026), choosing a participating university and field, in Kazakh, Russian or English.
official.study_mode: Full-time study for the full period of the programme (bachelor's, master's or PhD)
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international applicants, including holders of a refugee certificate, applying to study at universities in Kazakhstan participating in the programme
official.international_eligibility: Open to foreign applicants; the programme is aimed at international students studying at universities in Kazakhstan
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The choice of university and field of study is limited to the participating universities and available fields published on the Study In portal during the application window
official.research_requirement: PhD applicants must substantiate the topic of the dissertation research in the language of instruction
official.duration: The application covers the full period of study; the published pages do not state programme-specific durations
official.description: The Scholarship Program for Studying at Universities in Kazakhstan, operated by JSC 'Center for International Programs', awards government-funded places to international applicants at Kazakh universities, with applications submitted online through the Study in Kazakhstan portal in Kazakh, Russian or English.
official.program_type: Government scholarship operated by JSC 'Center for International Programs'
official.english_requirement: Master's and PhD applicants need an international language certificate - English: IELTS Academic at least 5.5, TOEFL iBT at least 46 or TOEFL PBT at least 453; equivalents published for German (DSH/TestDaF B2), French (TFI/DELF/DALF B2, TCF at least 50) and Chinese (HSK level 4) - not required if previous education was in the programme's language

selection criteria and the award process - not published on the pages read

verification.notes: The Center for International Programs' Scholarship Program page and its Requirements for bachelor's/master's/doctoral pages were read on 2026-10-10; the 490/50/10 place allocation, the 30 March - 31 May 2026 window (23:59 Astana time), the trilingual application rule and the full requirement set including the IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 46 / TOEFL PBT 453 thresholds were confirmed on bolashak.gov.kz.

applicant_utility.summary: The 2026 intake closed on 31 May 2026, so treat this as a next-cycle target: windows open around late March and the operator publishes the participating-university list only while applications are running. What you can prepare now is the document set - notarised translations, health and HIV/AIDS certificates issued by your country's official health authority, recommendation letters, and a motivational essay in Kazakh, Russian or English. Master's and PhD applicants need IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL iBT 46 / TOEFL PBT 453 or an equivalent unless their previous degree was already taught in the language of the programme.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International applicants - including refugees with a recognised certificate - who want a government-funded place at a Kazakh university and can apply in Kazakh, Russian or English.
application_readiness_checklist: Check the participating universities and fields on the Study In portal as soon as the window opens, since the list only exists during the application period
Get your previous-education documents translated and notarised into Kazakh, Russian or English early
Obtain the health certificate for travellers to study abroad and the HIV/AIDS status certificate from your country's official health authority - both are mandatory and slow
Secure one recommendation letter (bachelor's) or two (master's/PhD) from your school or employer
Book IELTS Academic (5.5+), TOEFL iBT (46+) or TOEFL PBT (453+) if applying to master's/PhD and your prior degree was not in the programme's language
Write the motivational essay in Kazakh, Russian or English, and for PhD prepare the dissertation-topic substantiation
common_rejection_risks: Applying when a level of education is not being pursued for the first time
Bachelor's applicants whose secondary-education average falls below the 'good' threshold, or master's/PhD applicants below a 3.0/4.0 GPA equivalent
Missing the notarised translation, which the rules attach to the education document itself
Waiting for the university invitation letter, which is 'if available' and not a requirement - missing the window waiting for one is the real risk
Assuming English-only application is possible: the application must be in Kazakh, Russian or English
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Not published - the official pages do not itemise what the funded places cover (tuition, maintenance, travel), so budget conservatively until the operator publishes the next intake's terms.
document_audit: The identity document category expressly includes a refugee certificate, so stateless applicants are not shut out
The HIV/AIDS certificate must come from the official health authority of the applicant's country of residence, not a private clinic
The application form has an official template on the site - download the current English version rather than improvising a CV-style form
alerts: The 2026 intake closed at 23:59 Astana time on 31 May 2026; the next window will be announced on the programme page and the operator's news page
Place numbers are capped by level (490/50/10), so competition concentrates in the bachelor's pool
The participating-university list exists only during the application window - research your options before it opens, not during
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Online application at studyin.kz/admission during the announced window, in Kazakh, Russian or English, selecting from the participating universities and fields published on the Study In portal.
